# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as an ugly man.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022)_

## Personality

He is decisive, able to make up his mind quickly. He possesses strong principles and offers practical moral advice to others.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Traits

- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>

## Goals

- to serve in a mission church in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended and graduated from St. Columbia. During his studies, he courted and became engaged to Philippa Gordon. Upon graduation, he prepared to take charge of a small mission church located on Patterson Street in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c27 P22](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0022), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)_
